# VELOXY
> The Best AI-Powered Field Sales Software for Salesforce Users.
Purpose: Provide actionable insights, tools, and resources for field sales and Salesforce CRM users.
Audience: Sales executives, sales managers, territory sales managers, regional sales managers, field sales reps, outside sales reps, sales enablement professionals, and Salesforce administrators worldwide.
Expertise: Field sales productivity, AI-powered automation, and CRM optimization.
========================
## Posts
========================
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/15-win-loss-analysis-questions/
Title: 15 Win-Loss Analysis Questions to Reinforce Your Sales Process
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: September 21, 2021
Updated Date: March 23, 2023
Summary:
This article provides a comprehensive guide to conducting win-loss analyses to strengthen sales processes by identifying why deals are won or lost. It defines win-loss analysis as the practice of gathering feedback from both customers and non-customers to understand decision-making factors, perceived strengths and weaknesses, and competitive positioning. The post outlines 15 detailed questions designed to uncover actionable insights, covering topics such as decision-making processes, key purchase influences, team interactions, product/service ratings, sales process timing, reasons for purchase or non-purchase, industry reputation, competitive differences, improvement suggestions, and additional feedback. The guide also explores questions about discovery sources, most valued features, areas for improvement, and factors that could have swayed a buying decision. Additionally, it presents “The 5 Rules of Successful Post-Decision Interviews,” emphasizing timely execution (within 3 months), a non-sales interview environment, possible outsourcing to unbiased third parties, the importance of perception, and the use of structured, metrics-based templates. The intended audience is sales leaders, account managers, and business development professionals seeking to improve sales outcomes and competitive edge. Readers will gain a ready-to-use question set, procedural guidelines for conducting effective post-decision interviews, and strategies for translating qualitative and quantitative feedback into sales process enhancements.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/sales-movies-and-tv-shows/
Title: The Ultimate List of Sales Movies & TV Shows
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: June 27, 2022
Updated Date: September 4, 2023
Summary:
This article curates a list of ten notable sales-focused movies and five television shows that inspire, educate, and motivate sales professionals. Drawing from client input, the post categorizes each entry with a brief synopsis, notable sales lessons, and viewing options. The movies range from high-pressure sales environments in “The Wolf of Wall Street,” “Boiler Room,” and “Glengarry Glen Ross,” to lighter, morale-boosting titles like “Tommy Boy” and “Cedar Rapids,” and emotionally resonant stories such as “The Pursuit of Happyness” and “Door to Door.” Each film is linked to specific sales traits—such as resilience, adaptability, client relationship building, and competitive drive—illustrated through memorable scenes and quotes. The list also includes “The Founder,” “Jerry Maguire,” and “The Internship,” emphasizing entrepreneurial mindset, personal connection, and problem-solving skills. The television selections—“Mad Men,” “Million Dollar Listings,” “The Office,” “Shark Tank” (and UK’s “Dragons’ Den”), and “The Profit”—highlight negotiation tactics, personal branding, sales persistence, and strategic thinking under scrutiny. The intended audience includes sales representatives, managers, trainers, and entrepreneurs seeking relatable and engaging portrayals of sales scenarios to spark creativity, reinforce best practices, or inspire team discussions. Readers will gain a curated viewing guide with clear takeaways for skill development, confidence building, and maintaining motivation during challenging periods.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/kpis-for-sales-operations/
Title: The 10 Essential KPIs for Sales Operations in 2023
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: September 5, 2022
Updated Date: September 4, 2023
Summary:
This article outlines 15 key performance indicators (KPIs) essential for evaluating and improving sales operations performance, organized into five metric categories: CRM metrics, sales funnel metrics, procedural metrics, sales resource KPIs, and financial KPIs. The opening section defines the scope of sales operations, noting responsibilities such as training sales agents, developing scripts, optimizing sales funnels, and improving lead generation, with the goal of increasing sales efficiency and ROI. Under CRM metrics, the guide covers Average Deal Value, Close Rate, and Upsell Rate. Sales funnel metrics include Pipeline Forecast, Open Opportunities, and Win Rate, helping assess pipeline health and conversion performance. Procedural metrics—Sales Cycle Length, Lead Generation Ratio, Lead Response Time, and Sales Forecast Accuracy—evaluate process efficiency. Sales resource KPIs, such as Sales Efficiency and Sales Agent Turnover Rate, focus on human capital management. Financial KPIs—Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), Customer Churn Rate, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)—address the bottom-line impact of sales activities. Each KPI is explained with definitions, calculation methods, and its strategic importance. The intended audience is sales operations managers, revenue leaders, and business analysts seeking a structured approach to measuring team effectiveness and identifying improvement areas. Readers will gain a clear framework for tracking performance across operational, personnel, and financial dimensions, enabling more accurate forecasting, better resource allocation, and targeted process optimization.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/linkedin-inmail-guide/
Title: A Comprehensive Guide to LinkedIn InMail in 2024
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: October 4, 2023
Updated Date: January 3, 2024
Summary:
This guide offers an in-depth overview of LinkedIn InMail, a premium messaging feature enabling outreach to professionals beyond one’s immediate network. It defines InMail, explains its purpose in bypassing first-degree connection limits, and outlines three types: Free (Premium users), Paid (Sales Navigator/Recruiter Lite), and Sponsored (via LinkedIn Ads). The article details character limits—8,000 for message body—and stresses concise, structured writing. Benefits highlighted include higher visibility, average response rates of 18–25% compared to 3% for cold email, and expanded access for sales and recruiting. Best practices are covered through sections on crafting attention-grabbing subject lines, personalization based on recipient profiles, and clear, actionable calls-to-action. Additional guidance compares when to use InMail versus standard LinkedIn messages, managing and purchasing InMail credits, and optimizing send times (e.g., weekdays 6–8 am or 8–10 pm). The guide provides sample templates for sales outreach, collaborations, partnerships, and event invitations, emphasizing customization. Measurement advice includes tracking response rates, acceptance rates, and engagement to refine strategy. The intended audience includes sales professionals, recruiters, and business development specialists seeking to maximize LinkedIn outreach efficiency. Readers will gain a full framework for using InMail strategically, from message composition and timing to credit management and performance evaluation.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/sales-quota/
Title: Sales Quota: The Complete Guide to Hitting & Crushing Quota in 2024
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: March 23, 2023
Updated Date: January 20, 2024
Summary:
This comprehensive guide examines sales quotas—defined as measurable sales targets set for individuals or teams within a specific time frame—and provides detailed strategies for setting, meeting, and exceeding them. It outlines three primary time-based quota types (monthly, quarterly, annual) and differentiates quotas from sales targets and goals. The article explains the business importance of quotas, including motivating performance, monitoring results, setting realistic expectations, and improving profitability. A five-step process for setting effective quotas covers identifying the sales cycle, determining target volumes, considering historical performance, evaluating resources, and establishing attainable goals. Additional sections describe activity, revenue, and profit quotas, and contrast individual versus team quota structures. Practical guidance for meeting quotas includes prospecting, following a defined sales process, building relationships, collaborating with peers, setting clear goals, and using incentives. “Crushing” quota involves setting higher personal goals, analyzing sales data, continuous learning, focusing on performance metrics, encouraging healthy competition, and emphasizing teamwork. The guide also addresses tracking metrics such as sales attainment, volume, conversion rate, and sales cycle length, with tools including CRM, sales performance management software, and business intelligence platforms. The article concludes with a framework for diagnosing and correcting shortfalls through performance reviews, feedback, targeted improvements, and action plans. Intended for sales representatives, managers, and revenue leaders, it provides a structured, metrics-driven approach to quota management from planning to execution and recovery.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/jordan-belfort-quotes/
Title: Sales Quota: 20 Jordan Belfort Quotes to Inspire Salespeople
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: May 24, 2022
Updated Date: March 7, 2024
Summary:
This article compiles 20 selected quotes from Jordan Belfort—known both as “The Wolf of Wall Street” and as a high-energy sales seminar leader—curated to inspire and motivate sales professionals. Belfort’s statements emphasize persistence, confidence, emotional influence, rapport-building, and strategic selling behaviors. The quotes address themes such as creating one’s own circumstances, treating failure as a learning process, using urgency and emotional certainty to close sales, recognizing behavioral patterns, employing power words, balancing logic with emotion in persuasion, and sustaining enthusiasm to establish expertise. Other advice focuses on controlling the sales conversation, matching body language to build rapport, and understanding that multiple “no’s” often precede a “yes.” The piece also touches on practical skills like making consistent eye contact, leveraging pain points to prompt action, and resisting the urge to mirror unproductive buyer behavior. Each quote is presented in full with attribution, making the resource useful for personal reflection, team motivation, or sales training sessions. The intended audience includes inside and outside sales representatives, sales managers, and trainers seeking concise, memorable principles to reinforce high-performance mindsets and selling techniques. Readers will gain a condensed, high-impact reference of Belfort’s motivational and tactical guidance applicable to daily sales practice.
###
URL: https://veloxy.io/the-wizard-of-sales-a-savvy-salesmans-guide-to-covert-hypnosis/
Title: The Wizard of Sales: A Savvy Salesman’s Guide to Covert Hypnosis
Category: Sales Best Practices
Author: Samir Majumdar
Publication Date: September 20, 2021
Updated Date: March 11, 2024
Summary:
This guide explores the concept of covert hypnosis—also known as “sleight of mouth”—and its application in sales to subtly influence prospects’ subconscious decision-making. It defines covert hypnosis as the practice of establishing unconscious communication without the subject’s awareness, often used in neuro-linguistic programming (NLP), and distinguishes it from traditional hypnotherapy. A key focus is on “pattern interrupt” techniques, which break habitual thought patterns to make individuals more receptive to suggestions. Four methods are detailed: Blocking (disrupting verbal or physical cues), Redirection (diverting focus through questions or reframing), System Overload (engaging multiple senses to overwhelm cognitive channels), and Confusion (using verbal ambiguity to pause thought processes). The article also presents six persuasion and hypnotic selling techniques: reframing a prospect’s mindset, repeating key points confidently, fostering authenticity, leveraging social proof, using precise and specific details, and creating perceived value. It emphasizes ethical use, understanding customer behavior patterns, and tailoring approaches to buyer personas. FAQs address the legitimacy of hypnosis in sales, the nature of hypnotic selling, and its adoption by high-performing professionals. Intended for sales representatives, managers, and trainers, the piece provides actionable methods for improving rapport, gathering information, and guiding prospects toward decisions through scientifically grounded psychological triggers.

The calculators include HubSpot’s Sales Metrics Calculator

Access Information From Anywhere
 
 
 
 
 
One of the biggest challenges for busy sales professionals is the fragmentation of tools across different apps and desktop programs.
Your sales reps probably use different apps for calendars, tasks, contacts, notes, reports, and other information.
This means they have to spend a lot of time and effort bouncing between various apps to get their work done.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Key Tools in a Single App
 
 
 
 
 
Veloxy changes all that by integrating the most important tools into a single app. With Veloxy, the calendar, tasks, contacts, notes, and sales reports become accessible from a central hub.
What’s more, because Veloxy is a mobile app, your sales reps can access all their essential business tools, whether they’re at a desk or on the go. No more being stuck without access to important customer information or reports just because they aren’t at a computer.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Veloxy Helps Your Teams Succeed
 
 
 
 
 
With Veloxy, your business is accessible with just a few taps on a phone or mobile device. Streamlining essential business tools into one seamless experience, Veloxy saves your reps time and boosts their efficiency. 
No more chaos—just simplicity and efficiency from a single source. The outcome? A sales team focused solely on your customers, providing higher quality service.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Optimize the Sales Process on the Go
 
 
 
 
 
With Veloxy, optimizing the sales process has never been easier. Key features like dynamically populated task lists, automated workflows, and detailed contact profiles ensure the sales process runs like a well-oiled machine:
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Task Lists That Adapt to the Day
 
 
 
 
 
Veloxy’s intelligent task manager adapts to the daily to-do list based on the calendar, upcoming calls, meetings, and past activities. Tasks are automatically generated for follow-ups, next steps with prospects and clients, and campaigns. Your team will never miss an important task again!
